concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-top-up-balance-account-on-demand-top-ups]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms user-funded Checkout `/payments` top-up guide for verified-bank or other-method funding, TopUp split booking, capability/direct-debit gates and asynchronous status tracking.
warnings: No `splits` array books funds to the platform liable account as a regular payment, not a user top-up; `/sessions` cannot initiate this route.

Verified-bank funding requires both receiveFromPlatformPayments and receiveFromTransferInstrument allowed/valid plus a SEPA/UK/US bank; other methods require receiveFromPlatformPayments allowed/valid.

UK BACS text requires advance notice at least 10 days before charge but lists due date two business days after initiation; reconcile timing before execution. `Authorised` is not user balance credit, payout or bank receipt.
